rule.forGateBlockedCounties: the ring and the coordinate index come from the parcel-table row whose prop_id IS the node's identity (fetched, and offered, only when the node id is present in that column -- a MEASURED membership, not an assumption); the published-identifier crosswalk and the owner-gated address recovery remain the fallbacks for a node id the parcel table does not carry. Never from cad_property by bare number.
rule.derivationUnchanged: the point remains ringCentroid(firstRing(ring)) -- the same derivation every county uses for lat_rounded/lng_rounded; only the SOURCE of the ring changes. The lots are Conway Addition Sec IV lots of about a quarter acre, so the ring centroid and the CAPCOG point are within tens of metres.
rule.landUseUntouched: land use on a gate-blocked county still comes from the owner-gated address join and nothing else.
